observedFrom: the public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org) dist-tags, versions, dependencies and dist.integrity of each package below
law: Every admitted release is one exact version in its own release manifest (VID0 R04, R05). A range, a versions array, an implied patch or minor, or a floating tag (latest, next, canary, nightly, beta) never decodes into a release (VID0 R07).

Activation reads the resolved installed version of the `marko` package and admits it only when it equals an admitted exact release (VID0 R06, R08; FWA1). Any other installed version is unsupported-version with the reason recorded below, never coerced.
The oracles are test-only devDependencies of the conformance harness. They are never product evidence, never parser or type authority, and never shipped.

admittedReleases.oracleCompatibility: the declared @marko/compiler range admits the oracle pin 5.42.10
admittedReleases.whyThisPatch: 6.4.3 is the newest published 6.4.x whose declared @marko/compiler range (^5.42.10) admits the LMK1-locked oracle @marko/compiler 5.42.10. 6.4.4 and 6.4.5 declare ^5.42.11, which excludes that oracle, so admitting them would diverge the product release from its oracle set.

excludedReleases.reason: oracle-divergence: these patches declare @marko/compiler ^5.42.11, which excludes the locked oracle 5.42.10. Admitting one is a new release manifest ratified together with a coordinated oracle re-pin of this lock and the LMK1 profile.

not-ratified: no later 6.x minor is published at ratification, so there is no exact version to pin. The npm `next` dist-tag resolves to 6.1.8, older than the admitted release, and a floating tag never decodes into a release (VID0 R07). A later 6.x is admitted only by a new release manifest naming its exact version, ratified here as a second admitted profile.

class-api-excluded: Marko 5 Class API components (`class {}` blocks, `this.state`, `this.input` on a component instance, `<include>`, sibling `component.js` / `component-browser.js` files) are a truthful exclusion. A Class API construct inside an admitted 6.4.3 package is a typed SyntaxReject (MRK1-AC4), never a silent Tags-API parse; mixing is reported by LMK3.

excludedReleases.selector: 6.4.3 followed by a pre-release suffix, or any canary, nightly or beta build
excludedReleases.reason: floating-or-prerelease: only the exact stable release decodes (framework-common versions; VID0 R07).

oracles.role: conformance oracle for grammar and tag semantics; never parser authority
oracles.note: Its own parser (htmljs-parser, a declared dependency) is reached only through this oracle and is never pinned or cited separately.

oracles.role: conformance oracle for the reference TS extraction shape; never product evidence
conformance oracle for facet and TS-region diagnostics agreement (MRK9-AC2); never product evidence

oracleSetSharedWith: LMK1 profile lock: the same three exact oracle versions. LMK1 states its marko line as "6.4.x latest stable"; that line resolves to this lock's admitted exact release, not to the registry latest tag (see XR01).
